;Disasters and accidents
*A bus skids off a mountain road into a {{convert|700|ft|adj=on}}–deep ravine in [[Uttarakhand]], [[India]], killing at least 48 people. [https://news.sky.com/story/at-least-44-dead-in-bus-crash-in-northern-india-11422467 (Sky News)]
*A road accident in [[Tanzania]] leaves 20 dead and 45 others injured. [http://www.xinhuanet.com/english/2018-07/02/c_137294138.htm (Xinhua)]

;International relations
*[[North Korea–United States relations]]
**[[U.S. President]] [[Donald Trump]]'s [[National Security Advisor (United States)|National Security Advisor]] [[John R. Bolton]] states that the [[United States]] has a plan to dismantle the [[North Korea and weapons of mass destruction|nuclear weapons]] program of [[North Korea]] in a year. [http://time.com/5327627/john-bolton-us-dismantle-north-korea-nuclear-weapons-1-year/ (''Time'')]

;Law and crime
*[[List of helicopter prison escapes]]
**Three heavily armed gunmen who hijacked a helicopter help [[Rédoine Faïd]], one of [[France]]'s most notorious gangsters, escape from a prison in [[Réau]], [[Île-de-France]]. Police later discovered the abandoned helicopter in [[Gonesse]]. Faïd previously escaped prison in 2013 and was briefly France's most wanted criminal. [https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-europe-44673753 (BBC)]
*[[Cannabis in the United States]]
**[[Cannabis in Vermont]]
***[[Vermont]] legalizes recreational [[marijuana]], becoming the ninth U.S. state to do so. [https://www.sfgate.com/news/us/amp/Vermont-becomes-9th-state-with-legal-recreational-13041624.php (''SFGate'')]
*[[Crime in Idaho]]
**A man stabs multiple people celebrating a three-year-old's birthday party at an apartment complex housing refugees in [[Boise, Idaho]]. Nine people are injured, including the birthday girl and five other children; the birthday girl dies the next day. [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-idaho-stabbings/stabbing-at-idaho-apartments-housing-refugees-leaves-9-wounded-idUSKBN1JR1NY (Reuters)]
*[[Terrorism in the United States]]
**[[FBI]] agents arrest a [[Cleveland]] man they say told an undercover agent he was planning to bomb a July 4<sup>th</sup> celebration. [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-usa-julyfourth-security/fbi-says-arrests-man-who-planned-to-bomb-cleveland-july-4-event-idUSKBN1JS1DJ (Reuters)]
;Politics and elections
*[[2018 German government crisis]], [[European migrant crisis]]
**[[Germany|German]] Chancellor [[Angela Merkel]] faces resistance by the [[Bavaria]]n [[Christian Social Union in Bavaria|CSU]] over the result of the [[European Union|EU]] asylum policy summit last week. [https://www.bloomberg.com/news/articles/2018-07-01/merkel-faces-crunch-time-in-coalition-showdown-on-migrant-policy (Bloomberg)] [http://www.faz.net/aktuell/politik/inland/regierungskrise-merkel-laesst-loesung-des-asyl-streits-mit-csu-offen-15668865.html (''Frankfurter Allgemeine'')]
**Interior minister [[Horst Seehofer]] offers his resignation citing a conflict with Angela Merkel over her refugee policy. [https://news.sky.com/story/german-interior-minister-quits-over-migration-conflict-11423348 (Sky News)]
*[[2018 Mexican general election]]
**Voters in [[Mexico]] elect [[Andrés Manuel López Obrador]] as their new [[President of Mexico|President ]] in a landslide victory. Additionally, 128 [[Senate of the Republic (Mexico)|senators]] and 500 [[Chamber of Deputies (Mexico)|deputies]] were also chosen. [https://www.politico.com/story/2018/07/01/mexico-election-trump-populist-lopez-obrador-664243 (''Politico'')] [https://www.bbc.com/news/world-latin-america-44677829 (BBC)]

;Sports
*[[2018 FIFA World Cup]]
**[[Russia national football team|Russia]] knocks out [[Spain national football team|Spain]] from the [[FIFA World Cup|World Cup]] after winning a penalty shootout. [https://www.thedenverchannel.com/sports/russia-spain-world-cup-shootout-upset (The Denver Channel)]
*[[2018 Mediterranean Games]]
**The closing ceremony of the 18th [[Mediterranean Games]] in [[Tarragona]], [[Spain]], takes place. [https://www.mundodeportivo.com/juegos-del-mediterraneo/20180702/45560467647/tarragona-despide-sus-juegos-mediterraneos-y-entrega-el-testigo-a-oran.html (''Mundo Deportivo'')]

;Health and environment
